k-apple.title: Apple AI agent report coins
k-apple.sourceSays: Posts say Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported Apple is developing an autonomous AI agent that controls devices, browses the web and writes code; coin accounts cite it for $iAgent and Apple Inu.
k-apple.reason: Posts of Nov 19-20 relay a Bloomberg report on Apple's AI agent (job postings); Apple Inu pool opened after it and a post ties it to the news. Only the report is attributed; coins are not endorsed.
